name: print-social-purple-ribbon-awareness-post-with-strikethrough-month
title: Awareness post with a giant lilac ribbon loop, a struck-through month name and three brain icons
whatItIs: A pale portrait with a huge lilac ribbon loop crossing from the top right to the bottom, a headline 'fevereiro roxo' in lilac and dark violet where 'roxo' is struck through by a hand-drawn line, three circular brain-icon badges, a short description, a thin arrow and a small brand dot.
whatItMeans: Gentle and purposeful; the ribbon is the symbol and the scribble adds warmth.
techniques: Use a giant ribbon shape as the hero.
Strike through a word with a handwritten line.
Add three small icons for topics.

vocabulary.definition: A looped ribbon symbol for a cause.
A scribble line through a word.
Text in lilac and dark violet.
